baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-II active participle mukadhdhibin at focus word 3 names agents who assign falsehood, not merely people who utter lies.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line attaches the day's woe to an active act of adverse judgment: these agents reject the truth-status of a report, sign, or bearer.

activation_trace.role: The literal act of declaring a thing or person false makes the focus noun an active adjudicative role in the mechanism.

changed_reading.after: A threat against agents who actively discredit a report, sign, or truth-bearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of mukadhdhibin at focus word 3 also carries an image in which a charge proves true by being carried through or false by failing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Their denial can be treated as a counter-claim put under pressure: woe marks the point at which that counter-position fails to carry through and thereby proves false in performance.

activation_trace.role: The literal success or failure of a charge supplies a performance test for the deniers' counter-claim.

changed_reading.before: The deniers hold an incorrect proposition.
changed_reading.after: The deniers mount a counter-position whose inability to carry through is itself its falsification.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of mukadhdhibin at focus word 3 includes images of an expected yield not lasting and an appearance that deceives by its condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Denial can be modeled materially as a sign that advertises one reality but cannot sustain the promised function or duration when tested.

activation_trace.role: The literal failure of an expected yield to continue contributes the durability test in this model.
The literal patterned surface that deceives by appearance contributes the mismatch between displayed identity and actual condition.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a false sentence.
changed_reading.after: Denial is a displayed reality that fails its advertised function or duration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening converts a threatened report into a fixed occurrence. The deictic 'that day' in the focus line therefore marks the temporal hinge at which the deniers' truth-assignment is refuted by eventhood.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsehood supplies the claim that the promised event will overturn.
The literal threatening promise supplies the report whose truth-status is contested.
Literal falling and becoming fixed turns the threatened report into an established event.

structural_cues: The opening oath sequence terminates at 77:7 with the promised matter characterized as occurring.
The focus line's yawma'idhin points back to a day already announced as event rather than mere discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a threatening promise and fixed occurrence; I supply the arrow from report to event as the refutation of takdhib. A live alternative is that waqi only intensifies certainty without staging a temporal conversion.

changed_reading.before: Woe follows an abstract error about a future claim.
changed_reading.after: Woe falls at the moment the denied warning changes from report into fixed event.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact recurrence makes the focus line an accumulating verdict checkpoint. Each return binds active falsification to the preceding domain, while 77:29 turns the denied object into an explicit destination.

activation_trace.role: The focus occurrence supplies the active verdict whose referential load has accumulated by its final return.
The first exact refrain establishes repeated active falsification as the surah's recurring checkpoint.
The verbal occurrence assigns falsehood to an explicit object, converting the recurring label into a consequence-bearing relation.

structural_cues: The identical woe line occurs at 77:15, 19, 24, 28, 34, 37, 40, 45, 47, and the focus 49.
The refrains follow distinct blocks about cosmic change, prior peoples, formation, earth, fire, speech, assembly, reward, enjoyment, and bowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition after changing blocks and direct-object takdhib at 77:29; I infer that each recurrence retains prior cases and expands the label. The alternative is non-accumulative rhetorical emphasis.

changed_reading.after: 77:49 is the final checkpoint in a refrain whose target has accumulated cosmic, historical, material, procedural, and bodily cases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible and solid orientation markers are successively erased, opened, and removed before a separating boundary is named. This cosmic dismantling gives the focus root's deceptive-surface model a world-scale test: apparent stability cannot preserve a false map.

activation_trace.role: The deceiving visible surface supplies the focus-side analogy for a world whose familiar appearance is stripped away.
The literal prominent visible thing supplies the first orientation marker subjected to reversal.
Literal erasure of a trace removes the visible marker on which the prior map depended.
The literal opening of a fissure turns an apparently continuous upper surface into exposed separation.
A literal elevated solid mass supplies the strongest image of stable visible structure.
Literal uprooting and removal makes even the strongest apparent structure fail its location.
Literal separation until a boundary appears supplies the revealed distinction after familiar surfaces collapse.

structural_cues: 77:8-13 moves from erased stars through opened sky and uprooted mountains to the day of separation.
The first refrain follows immediately after the question naming that separating day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visibility, solidity, erasure, opening, removal, and revealed boundary; I infer that these changes test the deniers' deceptive world-display. Alternatively, the sequence may depict destruction without any mirror relation to takdhib.

changed_reading.before: The deniers misdescribe a stable world.
changed_reading.after: Their denial depends on a visible world-map whose apparent stability is dismantled until its hidden boundary becomes manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The formation sequence places human life between weak origin, stable containment, and an earth that gathers living and dead. Against that container logic, denial becomes a bodily display of autonomy that deceives by concealing dependence.

activation_trace.role: The deceptive exterior supplies the analogy for an autonomous-looking body whose condition remains dependent.
Literal weakness and lowliness strip the body's origin of any self-sufficient appearance.
Literal stability and settlement supply the enabling containment on which formation depends.
Literal gathering and gripping in a vessel extends containment from gestation to the earth's hold on life and death.

structural_cues: 77:20-26 runs from weak fluid through a secure resting place to earth as a receptacle for living and dead.
Refrains close both the formation block and the earth block.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weakness, settlement, and enclosing collection; I infer a shared dependence architecture and treat apparent autonomy as a condition that lies. The live alternative is a simpler evidentiary reminder of creation and burial.

changed_reading.before: Deniers are detached minds rejecting an argument.
changed_reading.after: Deniers are dependent bodies whose performance of autonomy misrepresents the containers and measures that make their life possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deniers are sent without respite toward something named as shade, yet that named shelter neither covers nor suffices against flame. The environment thus performs takdhib materially: its displayed name and expected function do not agree.

activation_trace.role: Failure of an expected yield to last supplies the focus-side test of promised function.
A surface that deceives by its condition supplies the mismatch between the shelter's name and performance.
Literal unimpeded departure converts denial from a stationary stance into movement toward its consequence.
The literal covering function of shade supplies precisely the expectation that the verse negates.
Literal sufficiency supplies the second sheltering function explicitly denied to the shade.

structural_cues: 77:29 commands movement toward what was denied; 77:30 names a three-branched shade; 77:31 immediately negates shade and protection.
The refrain returns after the failed shelter and its fire imagery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compelled movement, a shelter-name, and negated cover and sufficiency; I infer a mirrored fit between active falsifiers and a false shelter. The alternative is that the shelter merely punishes denial without embodying its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are punished for a false representation.
changed_reading.after: They enter a representation made material: a thing called shade whose actual condition falsifies the shelter its name advertises.

context_deltas.mechanism: Agents who had assigned falsehood to another claim lose speech, permission, and excuse; truth and falsehood are then separated before an assembled field where their stratagem is challenged. The adverse judges become judged, and their counter-charge is tested as failed performance.

activation_trace.role: Declaring another claim false supplies the deniers' initial adjudicative posture, which the procedure reverses.
The literal failure of a charge under pressure supplies the test applied to their counter-case.
Literal excuse or exculpation supplies the defense that the scene does not permit them to complete.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the authoritative decision their own attribution cannot control.
Literal speech supplies the deniers' former instrument and its explicit suspension.
Literal authorization supplies the procedural standing that is withheld from their defense.
Literal gathering of the dispersed creates the common field in which every counter-claim is exposed together.
Literal stratagem supplies the challenged counter-measure whose nonperformance confirms failed resistance.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 removes speech, authorization, and excuse before 77:38-39 names separation, gathers parties, and challenges any stratagem.
Refrains bracket both the speechless hearing and the public challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disabled defense, truth-separating judgment, assembly, and challenged stratagem; I infer a procedural reversal from judging the message to being judged by it. An alternative is that these are separate incapacitation and power scenes rather than one hearing.

changed_reading.before: The deniers retain the role of evaluators who can reject a claim.
changed_reading.after: Their evaluative authority is reversed: they cannot plead, the truth-status is decided over them, and their counter-strategy fails in public performance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired consumption scenes tie wholesome enjoyment to intended action and recompense, but delimit the criminals' enjoyment as brief. This makes truth-status visible in lived performance and duration, activating both the failed-charge and failed-yield senses of the focus root.

activation_trace.role: Whether a charge carries through supplies the performance axis on which a lived stance is tested.
An expected yield that fails to last supplies the duration axis distinguishing the two enjoyments.
Literal intended action grounds the favorable consumption scene in performed conduct rather than verbal identity.
Literal matching of an act with its return makes consequence an evidentiary answer to conduct.
Literal extended continuance for enjoyment supplies the duration that the next word sharply restricts.
Literal smallness limits criminal enjoyment and makes its failure to endure explicit.

structural_cues: 77:43-44 links eating and drinking well to what was done and to recompense of those who do good.
77:46 repeats the eating command for criminals but limits enjoyment to a little, followed immediately by a refrain at 77:47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action-based recompense and a deliberately shortened enjoyment; I infer that these outcomes test which life-performance proves durable. Alternatively, the pairing may contrast rewards without redefining takdhib as performance.

changed_reading.before: Denial is tested only by whether a sentence is correct.
changed_reading.after: Denial is tested by what a life carries through and whether its apparent benefit can endure its consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate antecedent presents a commanded bodily lowering and its repeated nonperformance. The focus refrain therefore classifies refusal in posture as takdhib: the body enacts the adverse truth-claim before any sentence is quoted.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in both speech and action allows the focus label to attach to a bodily nonresponse.
Failure to carry through a charge supplies the nonperformance mechanism of the refused command.
Literal bending and lowering the head supplies the concrete action commanded and then negated.
Literal humility and abasement make the absent posture a refusal of relational submission, not mere missed motion.

structural_cues: 77:48 repeats the same root in command and negated response, and 77:49 follows without intervening material.
This is the final refrain before the surah's closing question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded lowering, explicit non-lowering, and immediate refrain adjacency; I infer that the refrain categorizes bodily refusal as active falsification. The alternative is that 77:49 resumes the general refrain without specially glossing 77:48.

changed_reading.before: Mukadhdhibin are people who verbally reject a proposition.
changed_reading.after: At the focus point, mukadhdhibin includes those whose unbending body performs refusal of humility and thereby makes the denial visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question sets renewed discourse, temporal succession, and heart-settling assent against the completed refrain sequence. The focus line becomes a threshold: repeated active falsification has exhausted the prospect that a later report will secure trust.

activation_trace.role: Repeated active attribution of falsehood supplies the cumulative refusal that the final question tests.
Literal discourse renewed as news supplies the hypothetical next message after this one.
Literal temporal after-ness places any alternative report beyond the completed warning sequence.
Literal assent in which the heart finds rest supplies the uptake that no later discourse is expected to produce.

structural_cues: 77:50 follows the focus refrain directly and asks what discourse after it they will trust.
The final question closes a surah whose refrains have repeatedly renamed them by active falsification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed report, temporal succession, and settled assent; I infer an exhaustion arrow from accumulated takdhib to failed future uptake. The alternative is a claim about the present discourse's supremacy rather than the deniers' settled incapacity.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns rejection of one message.
changed_reading.after: The focus marks the end-state of repeated rejection, where even a later renewed report has no remaining route to settled assent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a root-idiom of running and then stopping, not the direct morphology of mukadhdhibin. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains sequence support from commanded departure and the final 'after'; downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic analogy, never as a lexical replacement for active denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 carries a branch image of a runner that completes a stretch, stops, and looks back.

activation_trace.role: The literal run-then-stop image supplies an interrupted-motion contour for the focus root.
Literal unimpeded departure supplies the forward movement that will not become escape.
Literal temporal after-ness supplies the blocked prospect of continuing beyond the warning into a new discourse.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a settled stationary opinion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial traces an interrupted flight: movement toward the denied consequence ends in a stop from which no later discourse opens escape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus participle is not the idiom in which the root urges that something is incumbent upon a person. It remains root-anchored and is activated by the immediately preceding spoken demand to bow; downstream prose should label it a branch echo of obligation, not translate mukadhdhibin as 'the obligated.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 shares a root branch whose idiomatic force is urging that a demanded act is incumbent.

activation_trace.role: The literal idiom of urging or obligation supplies the unexpected echo that a denied demand returns as binding.
Literal articulated speech supplies the explicit demand immediately before the focus line.
Literal bending and lowering supplies the concrete demanded act whose refusal activates the obligation echo.

changed_reading.before: The refrain only labels people after they refuse the command.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, the refused bowing returns at the refrain as an obligation that their denial could not cancel.

strongest_changes: The repeated line became an accumulating verdict checkpoint rather than an isolated curse.
The immediate refusal to bow made takdhib bodily nonperformance, not only verbal rejection.
The non-sheltering shade materialized denial as a name or appearance that fails its advertised function.
The closing question turned the focus line into the threshold after which no later report is expected to secure settled assent.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah alternation let the same short refrain collect distinct mechanisms from event actualization, cosmic surface failure, material containment, procedure, consequence, and posture. The focus root's branches of failed charge, failed duration, and deceptive appearance became diagnostic without displacing the direct form-II sense of active falsification.
remaining_uncertainties: The failed-charge, failed-yield, deceptive-surface, runner, and obligation branches are root-level analogies and should remain subordinate to the direct active-falsification model.
Semantic accumulation across exact refrains is inferred from placement; exact repetition could instead function as non-accumulative emphasis.
The mirrored relation between deniers and false shelter is live but not forced; the shelter may expose or punish denial without embodying it.
